development.history: Existing fictional history retains U1/P-101 three selected orders and 2.5 booked hours under its declared signed ledger; U2/P-101 has one order and 3 booked hours; no labor rows is unavailable, not zero
development.drawing: A prepared drawing-return finding keeps requested/observed/unverifiable states and exact original request/source/revision; a supplied mapping is not proof of plant identity
development.source_qualification: Every projected assertion points to its supplied source record/version/locator and interpretation limit; full source content remains retained
development.typed_values: false, zero, null, empty and unknown have distinct retained meanings; roundtrip comparisons are type-sensitive
development.review: Unreviewed and disputed facts remain so; company acceptance/authenticated authority remain unestablished
development.receiving: Actual existing receiver reads every represented record and dependency with complete relevant content; omissions from native representation are enumerated and source content is preserved
development.portability: Relocated receiving copy and subsequent export/reopen reproduce selected substantive content without the producer's original paths

revision_cycle: A source-only change reopens its dependent finding and combined-source synthesis
An independent-source answer retains its status and complete prior history
Earlier originals, findings, owners and decision declarations remain reconstructable
An omitted source/order is explicit and never equated with closure/removal/acceptance
Competing proposals remain visible; changing their arrival order does not choose a winner
Stale base, duplicate delivery or incomplete/lost history is refused or explicitly reconciled before publication
Retry/reopen cannot silently append duplicate accepted decisions or replace a newer receiving record
wrong_controls: Missing original or changed bytes under unchanged revision
Dropped represented field, relationship, source qualification or history
Unreviewed claim promoted to company acceptance
Changed mapping/authority/base hidden as an ordinary correction
Old source/source-dependent answer retained as current after selected revision
Reference escapes retained packet or output aliases an original
Partial receiving result counted as full successful transfer
baseline: Exact-file inventory/copy preserves byte counts but supplies no scoped identity mapping, claim/dependency admission or revised-source reopening; measure on identical supplied inputs

reserved.selection: One second fictional unit with disjoint identity namespace, differently named semicolon maintenance exports, a corrected drawing request and one unavailable source; fixed before reserved content is opened
reserved.freeze_required: tool/adapter/receiver/scorer identities and declared exposure before execution
reserved.interpretation: author-run procedural transfer; no independent human/site or arbitrary-format claim
